messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly pulse — short and actionable.
Ava (CEO): TL;DR — Private GA pilot passed internal checks, cost per 1k tokens down ~12% MoM, we had a brief Wed 03:40 UTC incident that impacted p95 latency for ~9m. Key asks below.
Ava (CEO): Asks: 1) Infra/SRE: finish incident postmortem by EOD Friday and push hotfix for autoscaler. 2) Eng: prioritize KV-cache P95 improvements for next sprint. 3) Product: finalize Private GA messaging + pricing for Dedicated. 4) PeopleOps: slow hiring of IC infra until reliability PRs land.
Juniper (Head of Infra): Quick update — postmortem draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/pm/17642 (link). Root cause: autoscaler race on node reclamation + cold KV cache. Mitigations: revert aggressive scale-to-zero, add circuit-breaker.
Noah (Director, SRE): Saw the p99 CPU spike at 03:42 UTC, fallback routing to smaller model prevented customer errors. I've pinned the fallback policy for next 48h.
Noah (Director, SRE): Will assign oncall to write runbook sections for this failure mode by tomorrow.
Maya (Head of Eng): Can confirm an engineering fix for the autoscaler race is in review (PR #4821). Also adding a KV cache warming step to canary rollout.
Maya (Head of Eng): Plan: canary Fri 10:00 UTC -> 25% Sat -> full Mon if green.
Sam (VP Product): Private GA pilot update: onboarding playbook ready, docs are in product/docs/private-ga-playbook.md. Need legal sign-off on DLP line items.
Ibrahim (CFO): Legal and compliance cleared the DLP wording (see thread). Also ran cost sensitivity — Dedicated pricing update proposal attached: https://redwood.internal/costs/dedicated-q2 (link).
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: `./deploy --canary --percent=15 --tag=autosc-fix-rtc` — 10:12 UTC — no errors in first 30m.
Ava (CEO): Thank you all. A couple of things I want visible to execs: hiring velocity targets, runway impact of Dedicated pricing, and a short customer note template for the incident. Can someone own the template?
Sam (VP Product): I'll take the customer note template. Will share draft by EOD Thurs.
Juniper (Head of Infra): I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with SRE for the runbook.
Ibrahim (CFO): I'll update exec deck with revised Dedicated numbers by Monday.
Ava (CEO): Two strategic asks — 1) Continue the push on cost/performance (we should aim another 8–10% unit cost reduction next quarter). 2) Keep GA messaging clear: 'predictable latency, flexible deployment, SLA-ready.'
Noah (Director, SRE): Quick FYI — no active incidents. Monitoring dashboards updated with new p95 alert thresholds.
Maya (Head of Eng): Noted on the cost target, we'll include quantization + batching experiments in the plan.
Ava (CEO): Final: please react with :thumbsup: once you have action ownership. Thanks — Ava.
